w.doc: Mean energy per quantum W (PRD Eq. 1); 13.7 eV

field.doc: PandaX-4T drift field. Run0 ~93 V/cm (this default); Run1 ~84 V/cm (override per run).

liquid_xe_density.doc: Liquid xenon density (NESTv2.0 ER Wq / Qy / alpha)

p0_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p0, FIT to the digitized Fig.17 yield curve at xi_norm_er=30 (free LS, no Table-II prior). Reproduces LY/QY to ~0.2% with no residual structure. NOT the published Table II value 1.1: Table II at xi_norm=150 leaves a ~1% mid-energy wobble (PandaX's degenerate ER coeffs are ~1% inconsistent with their own Fig.17 curve). See [[project_pandax_4t]].

p1_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p1, fit to Fig.17 at xi_norm_er=30 (Table II value -3.1 is for xi_norm=150)

p2_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p2, fit to Fig.17 at xi_norm_er=30 (Table II value 2.2 is for xi_norm=150)

p3_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p3, fit to Fig.17 at xi_norm_er=30 (Table II value -1.7 is for xi_norm=150)

a_er.doc: P4-NEST ER recombination-fluctuation scaling A^ER (PRD Table II)

d_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Run1 recombination shift. 0 for Run0; fitting the digitized Run1 LY+QY at xi_norm_er=30 gives ~-0.029 (close to Table II's d_ER=-0.032). Both ER and NR Run1 prefer d~-0.03; the listed d_NR=-0.043 matches neither.
